statusMessage: AssertionError: Teams listing stayed in a loading state past the configured timeout.
statusTrace:
pages/teams_page.py:217: in _wait_for_loading_to_finish
    expect(loading).to_have_count(0, timeout=LONG_TIMEOUT)
E   AssertionError: Locator expected to have count '0'
E   Actual value: 1 
E   Call log:
E     - Expect "to_have_count" with timeout 45000ms
E     - waiting for locator("[aria-busy='true']:visible, [role='status']:visible")
E       5 × locator resolved to 1 element
E         - unexpected value "1"

During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:
tests/e2e/admin/test_teams.py:225: in test_team_name_sorting_toggles_deterministically
    teams_page.assert_column_toggles_sort_order("Team Name")
pages/teams_page.py:93: in assert_column_toggles_sort_order
    self._wait_for_listing_update()
pages/teams_page.py:760: in _wait_for_listing_update
    self._wait_for_loading_to_finish()
pages/teams_page.py:219: in _wait_for_loading_to_finish
    raise AssertionError("Teams listing stayed in a loading state past the configured timeout.")
E   AssertionError: Teams listing stayed in a loading state past the configured timeout.
